explanation: Mate is often shared from a single gourd among friends in Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay and southern Brazil. Emigrants returning from South America also made it a popular drink in Syria.

claims.text: Yerba mate is traditionally drunk from a gourd through a metal straw with a filter, called a bombilla.
Guaraná, chicha and horchata are not traditionally drunk from a gourd through a bombilla.
Yerba mate is commonly shared from a single gourd in Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay and southern Brazil.
Emigrants returning from South America brought the mate habit to Syria, where it became a popular drink.
